HEAD ships the UNITS2 round-1 GLBs for 11 fighters instead: ardit, burdam, hesmi, ilsheta, kemdo, marund, nurrow, rishal, sukri, tunlan and vashil. The lead must decide whether to restore those GLBs and zone_grades.json to 72cd0f20e or to apply the Ilsheta keepUV face fix. The verifier did not edit either, because the role does not allow it.
